title: MonotonicClock accepts async callbacks and leaks unawaited coroutine objects
description: Fresh final timing robustness review: MonotonicClock validates only callable(callback). An async function is accepted; each clock read creates a coroutine, _mono rejects it, and the coroutine is never closed/awaited, producing resource warnings and possible captured-resource retention on every status/adopt path. Reject coroutine functions at construction and defensively close/reject any awaitable returned by a callable object, without changing domain identity or tracker state. Add async-function and awaitable-returning-object tests under warnings-as-errors.
